hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *) pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); h=$(printf '%s' "$c" | sed -e "s/<<'\\?[A-Za-z_]*'\\?[\\s\\S]*//"); printf '%s' "$h" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(]|&&|\|\|)[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+stash([[:space:]]|$)' && { echo 'Zakazano: git stash. Rozdelanou praci neodkladej, dokonci ji nebo si zaloz worktree.' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$h" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(]|&&|\|\|)[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+(checkout|switch)[[:space:]]' && { echo 'Zakazano: prepinani vetvi v tomhle checkoutu. Potrebujes-li jinou vetev, zaloz worktree z HEAD.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
